Package Manager: Linux distribution package managers (e.g., apt, yum, homebrew)
Method of Attack: Malware injection via social engineering and binary test files
Exploitation of IFUNC calls in glibc to bypass ssh authentication
Impacted Systems: Development machines using tools like homebrew
Attack Vector: Malicious binary test files embedded in source code
Indicators of Compromise: Slow ssh login times (e.g., 500ms instead of 100ms)
Presence of xz or liblzma versions 5.6.0 or 5.6.1
